name: Tate's Bake Shop Factory - East Moriches NY

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single open driveway off Pine St with a TATE'S monument sign at the corner; no barrier arm, no controlled checkpoint. A short decorative fence segment exists near the sign but is pedestrian-scale, not a truck barrier.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. Only a small office annex on the NE side of the building, well inside the property, not a gate-side guard structure.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Driveway meets a quiet two-lane public road with the dock apron close to the entrance and very little internal stacking room; a truck queue would back toward the road.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Small 40,000 sq ft bakery. Loading occurs on the north building face; satellite z21 shows ~4 trailers/units backed against the wall plus a couple of additional bays. Estimated band 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few trailers parked along the north apron without tractors; small count, band 0-10.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Gate-to-dock approach holds only 1-2 trucks; loading apron is immediately inside the entrance.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main bakery building plus a small attached/adjacent office annex on the NE corner.
